name: kotlin
description: Installs Kotlin tooling and optional Kotlin kernel (kotlin-jupyter)

KOTLIN_KERNEL_VERSION.description: kotlin-jupyter KERNEL PACKAGE release (PyPI 'kotlin-jupyter-kernel', pinned in checksums.json tools.kotlin-jupyter). NOT the notebook Kotlin language level: the wheel bundles its own compiler runtime (2.4.0-dev-6891) and this value is independent of KOTLIN_VERSION (which only pins the SDKMAN CLI compiler). Package is marked 'Development Status :: 4 - Beta' on PyPI.

KOTLIN_KERNEL_WHEEL_URL.description: Direct wheel URL override (default empty: resolved from checksums.json tools.kotlin-jupyter.archive_url_template; PyPI path is content-hashed, so it cannot be templated from the version). Whatever the source, the sha256 in checksums.json is always enforced.

postInstallCheck.command:
bash -lc 'kotlinc -version 2>&1 | tail -n 1; v="${INSTALL_KOTLIN_KERNEL:-false}"; case "${v,,}" in true) python - <<PY
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from jupyter_client.kernelspec import KernelSpecManager

ksm = KernelSpecManager()
try:
    spec = ksm.get_kernel_spec("kotlin")
except Exception as exc:
    raise SystemExit(f"kotlin kernelspec missing: {exc}")
if not os.path.isfile(os.path.join(spec.resource_dir, "kernel.json")):
    raise SystemExit(f"kotlin kernelspec incomplete: {spec.resource_dir}")
print(f"kotlin kernelspec OK: {spec.resource_dir}")

found = importlib.util.find_spec("run_kotlin_kernel")
if found is None or not found.origin:
    raise SystemExit("kotlin kernel module run_kotlin_kernel not importable")
mod = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(found.origin))
jars = os.path.join(mod, "jars")
cfg = os.path.join(mod, "config", "jar_args.json")
if not os.path.isdir(jars):
    raise SystemExit(f"kotlin kernel payload missing jars dir: {jars}")
if not os.path.isfile(cfg):
    raise SystemExit(f"kotlin kernel payload missing jar_args: {cfg}")
main_jar = json.load(open(cfg))["mainJar"]
if not os.path.isfile(os.path.join(jars, main_jar)):
    raise SystemExit(f"kotlin kernel payload missing main jar: {main_jar}")
print(f"kotlin kernel payload OK: {main_jar}")
PY
 ;; *) echo "kotlin postInstallCheck: kernel not requested (INSTALL_KOTLIN_KERNEL=$v); asserting compiler only";; esac'
postInstallCheck.description: Verify Kotlin compiler is available and, when INSTALL_KOTLIN_KERNEL=true, that the 'kotlin' kernelspec resolves and the run_kotlin_kernel payload (jars/, config/jar_args.json, main jar) is complete
